This page is an index, like the one at the back of a book: it lists where words and phrases appear across the conversations with each AI. It does not interpret what they mean. A message counts once if it has a match. “Alex own words” counts matches inside the conservative own-words selection; “Alex-labeled” counts every message labeled Alex, which can include text he pasted from an AI; “AI” counts messages labeled as an AI. A long or resumed chat can contain messages written after its start date. No JavaScript is required. Plain text for AIs: subject-map/INDEX.txt · data: subject-map.json · corrections: overrides.json.
